semantics.mutation_rule: out-of-place entry leaves input immutable; explicit in-place entry atomically replaces the same slice only after complete success
semantics.alias_rule: out-of-place returns fresh storage; in-place preserves the caller-provided allocation identity
semantics.shape_rule: preserves every input element and logical shape
semantics.dtype_rule: the functional adapter accepts contiguous f32; its analytical derivative reuses CpuBackend's canonical scalar sigmoid
semantics.accumulation_dtype: f32 elementwise exponential, addition, and division
semantics.device_rule: CPU exact native execution; non-CPU requires a separately certified adapter and returns typed unavailable here
semantics.numeric_rule: computes input divided by one plus exp of negative input in fixed f32 order with NaN and infinity propagation
semantics.tolerance: absolute 0.000001 for forward and 0.0003 for finite-difference gradient fixtures
semantics.determinism: fixed scalar formula with no RNG
semantics.cancellation_points: before temporary allocation, at bounded element intervals, and before in-place commit; cancellation leaves input unchanged
semantics.vjp_rule: analytical SiLU VJP using sigmoid times one plus input times one minus sigmoid
